title: 60-Second Lead Response for Marketing Agencies
metaDescription: Build a lead-response workflow for eligible agency enquiries, with a 60-second service target, approved context, routing and a booking link.
excerpt: A lead-response workflow can give each eligible enquiry a fast, consistent first reply while keeping the team informed and ready to take over.

sections.intro:
A prospect can submit a form while the team is in client work, after hours or during a busy launch. A delayed reply creates an avoidable gap between interest and the next step.

The 60-Second Lead Engine is designed to send a personalized first reply against an agreed service target, include the right booking link and alert the team at the same time. A human can review or take over when the enquiry needs judgement.

This is the Capabilities layer of an AI Operating System. We offer a focused first build so you can evaluate it on your own workflow before considering a wider system.
sections.fourCFit:
The 60-Second Lead Engine is a focused, measurable Capability that depends on the other three Cs:

  • Context: approved examples and rules shape the reply.
  • Connections: the agreed form, inbox, calendar and CRM trigger and record the workflow.
  • Capabilities: the first reply, routing, booking link and human handoff.
  • Cadence: optional follow-up runs on an agreed schedule and stops when the prospect replies.

See how this fits the wider AI Operating System for Marketing Agencies.
sections.whatDoneLooksLike:
The service target and controls are concrete:

  • Eligible enquiries trigger a first reply against the agreed 60-second target.
  • The reply uses approved lead details, agency facts and voice examples.
  • The correct booking link is selected from current calendar rules.
  • The right person receives the enquiry, source and a copy of the reply.
  • The CRM is updated using agreed matching and source-of-truth rules.

Optional follow-up runs on the agreed cadence and stops when the prospect replies or a person takes over.
sections.howWeInstall:
Three phases:

  1. Fit check. Confirm the lead source, available integrations, approved reply examples and human handoff.
  2. Install the Lead Engine. Connect the scoped form, inbox, calendar and CRM, then test expected and edge cases before enabling live sends.
  3. Operate, optional. Continue monitoring and improving the workflow or expand into a wider AIOS plan. See plans.
sections.expectedResults:
The build is evaluated against your own baseline and the service level agreed in scope.

  • Measure time from form submission to first reply.
  • Check that each reply uses approved facts and the correct next step.
  • Track human takeovers, delivery failures and stopped follow-up sequences.
  • Compare booked-call and qualification rates before and after without promising a lift.
sections.faq:
What does the free build include?

The scoped Lead Engine connects the agreed lead source and reply channel, uses examples you approve and includes a clear human handoff. Exact integrations are confirmed during the fit check.

What happens after the free build?

You can keep the focused workflow, add managed monitoring or scope a wider AI Operating System. There is no obligation to expand.

Who owns the system?

You own the prompts, connections and automations built in your accounts.
